events.title: SEBI CAS/market-timing/derivatives settlement changes take effect: CAS 15:30-15:40; index F&O trade to 15:45 (expiring index contracts stop 15:30 on expiry day); stock F&O to 15:45 incl. expiry; expiry settlement on last-30-min VWAP of CTS
events.notes: SEBI circular HO/47/11/11(3)2025-MRD-POD2/I/23843/2026 dated 15 Oct 2026, para 6.1: effective December 07, 2026 (para 4.8 order-carry-over rules from 08 Feb 2027). PDF https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebi_data/attachdocs/oct-2026/1792079571420.pdf ; NSE circular NSE/CMTR/76963 (16 Oct 2026) is a cover circular enclosing that SEBI circular (https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/circulars/CMTR76963.zip ; cover text also at https://goyalandassociates.com/static/circulars/NSE_CMTR_76963/CMTR76963.pdf). Exact times from SEBI para 4.2: CAS 15:30-15:40 (transition 15:30 1min; order entry both 15:31 5min; limit-only+random close 15:36 4min, random 15:38-15:40); index F&O trade to 15:45 except expiring index contracts stop 15:30 on expiry day; stock F&O to 15:45 incl. expiry; cash post-close 15:50-16:00; expiry settlement on last-30-min VWAP of CTS (para 4.9). Equity CTS close for CAS securities: 15:30 (CAS starts at 15:30; reference price = last 15 min of CTS per para 4.3.1). Re-read SEBI PDF on 2 Nov 2026 weekly cycle. Does NOT change expiry weekday (still Tuesday / last Tuesday per NSE/FAOP/68747). First affected expiry: NIFTY weekly 8 Dec; first affected monthly 29 Dec. Note: NSE CAS FAQ v3 (Oct 2026) still quotes pre-change 15:15-15:35 timings in places — use the SEBI 15 Oct circular for Dec-7 times.
